responsibility: Declares the text-diagnostics helpers for unwinding macro expansions in libcpp-based source locations. It exposes the finalizer entry point that front ends can chain into their diagnostic text finalization and the lower-level helper for emitting expansion notes for a specific location, separating macro-trace support from the rest of the text-format implementation.
same_name_distinction: This header is the declaration side of the macro-unwinding pair: unlike gcc/diagnostic-macro-unwinding.cc, which performs the actual macro-expansion unwinding and note emission, it merely exposes the finalizer and helper functions for other diagnostic text code to call.
